trim-drift/gmc-sierra-ev-2026-denali-ext.why: Not drift — GMC itself publishes 4.5s across 605hp, 645hp and 760hp Sierra EV configurations. The heavier Extended Range pack offsets the extra power. Independently re-confirmed against GMC's own trim pages; Edmunds separately measured the Denali Extended Range at 4.4s.

model-year/lexus-es-2027-350e-fwd/MY2027.why: Real divergence between the manufacturer and EPA, not a drifted record. Lexus's own press release (2026-08-10) designates the battery-electric ES models MY2027; EPA certified them under MY2026, and Edmunds catalogues them as 2026. modelYear follows Lexus's designation, which is what a buyer sees. The range check passes against the same EPA entry (307mi), so the car is matched correctly.

model-year/lexus-es-2027-500e-awd/MY2027.why: Same divergence as the 350e: Lexus designates MY2027, EPA certified MY2026. The range check passes against the same EPA entry (276mi), confirming the record is matched to the right vehicle.

unit-tell/porsche-cayenne-electric-2026-.why: Not a converted European figure — Porsche's own US site publishes exactly this number. porsche.com/usa quotes 7,716 lbs for the Cayenne Electric with the optional tow hitch. The heuristic is right that it is round in metric (3,500 kg); it is wrong that this makes it non-US. Some makers publish the metric-derived figure as their US spec.

unit-tell/porsche-macan-electric-2025-4-.why: Not a converted European figure — Porsche USA publishes 4,409 lbs for the Macan Electric, matching the combustion Macan's rating. Correct for MY2025; note Porsche raised the Macan 4, 4S and Turbo to 5,500 lbs for MY2026, so this value must not be carried forward if these records move to 2026.

unit-tell/mini-countryman-electric-2025-.why: Not a converted European figure — MINI USA publishes exactly this. Its own specs page states 'a towing capacity of up to 2,645 pounds with the available factory-installed trailer hitch', and the same number appears in the page's FAQ structured data and a spec row. The factory hitch is offered in the US. Same pattern as the Porsche entries: round in kg (1,200) and still the manufacturer's own US spec.
